current_evidence: The council's planning applications page links the 'Local Validation Checklist' (file 1459), the 'Validation matrix' (file 1470, #page=81) and an adoption statement saying the council 'formally adopted the Local Validation Checklist on 11th July 2024'. A search found no 2025 or 2026 revision.

issues.detail: The list date (2024-08-01) comes from PDF metadata. The council's adoption statement gives the adoption date as 11 July 2024.
issues.evidence: Adoption statement (file 1533): 'formally adopted the Local Validation Checklist on 11th July 2024'

issues.detail: File 1470, labelled 'validation checklist matrix', is not just a matrix. It is the full 'Validation Checklist 2024' with the matrix on p.81. The council also hosts a near-identical version as file 1459, whose contents page puts the matrix on p.80. Grokbot mixed sources from both files, which is why the tab items repeat each other.
issues.evidence: Planning page links 'Local Validation Checklist' (file 1459) and 'Validation matrix for planning applications' (file 1470#page=81). Both are titled 'Validation checklist 2024'.

issues.detail: Coal Mining Risk Assessment is placed under exactly the application types the source exempts: Householder, Listed building consent, Lawful development cert, Change of use - prior approval, Works to trees and Hazardous substances. It is missing from Full planning and Outline, where it does apply in Coal Authority high-risk areas.
issues.evidence: 'development proposals located in an area defined as "high risk area" by the Coal Authority, other than: householder development, heritage consents (listed building), lawful development certificates, prior notification (any type), hazardous substances consents, and tree or hedgerow works'

issues.detail: The Lighting Assessment and 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' rows are placed under Outline, but the trigger they quote exempts outline applications with all matters reserved. The 'Advertisement drawings' rows under Full planning and Outline actually quote the Lighting Impact Assessment, not an advertisement requirement.
issues.evidence: Lighting Impact Assessment: 'major development proposals that include external lighting/ illumination (with the exception of outline planning applications where appearance, landscaping, layout and scale are reserved'

issues.detail: Three rows under Listed building consent use the Heritage Statement trigger text under the wrong requirement names: 'Health Impact Assessment', 'Landscaping scheme / Landscape plan' and 'Photographs / Photomontages'. A Health Impact Assessment is required for major development, not LBC.
issues.evidence: LBC 'Health Impact Assessment' excerpt: '...Health Impact Assessment SPD 2021 33 Heritage Statement (Statement of Significance) When it this required? listed building consent applications...'

issues.detail: Most Full planning rows carry the note 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. The source has a Validation Checklist Matrix (p.81) that marks each requirement E (Essential) or P (Possible) for 13 application types, but Grokbot did not use it. As a result, Householder, Reserved matters, Advertisement consent, s73, Approval of details and NMA show '(none)' or are wrong. For example, the Sustainable Design and Construction Checklist applies to 'All planning applications' but appears nowhere, and the Tree Survey/AIA is listed only under Works to trees, when it is a development-application requirement.
issues.evidence: Matrix columns: Householder, Full, Outline, LBC, Advertisement, LDC Existing/Proposed, Prior Notification, Reserved Matters, Removal/Variation of Condition, Approval of Details, Tree Works, NMA; key 'E = Essential Requirement; P = Possible Requirement'

issues.detail: The Sustainable Design and Construction Checklist is missing. It is required with every planning application.
issues.evidence: 'All planning applications must be accompanied by a complete sustainable design and construction checklist'

issues.detail: Several local requirements are missing entirely: Building for a Healthy Life Assessment (major residential); Crime and Disorder Statement (major development, hot food takeaways, pubs/licensed premises, public toilets); Community Services and Facilities - Justification for Loss (loss of a community facility); Loss of land in or allocated for Economic Development - justification statement (non-employment uses on employment land/buildings); Rural Building Conversion - Justification Statement (conversion of rural buildings); and Surface Water Drainage Assessment (all major development, and development with surface water drainage in an area at risk of flooding).
issues.evidence: Part Two headings in the Validation checklist 2024; e.g. Rural Building Conversion: 'applications for the conversion of rural buildings'; Surface Water Drainage: 'major development proposals; and development with surface water drainage in an area at risk of flooding'

issues.detail: The Heritage Statement, Tree Survey/AIA, Archaeological Assessment and Coal Mining Risk Assessment are all missing from Full planning. The Heritage Statement appears only under LBC, although it also applies to major and conservation-area development and to proposals affecting heritage assets. The Tree Survey/AIA appears only under Works to trees, and the Archaeological Assessment only under Outline (sites near scheduled monuments or listed buildings, or over 0.2ha).
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement: 'listed building consent applications; major planning applications within or otherwise affecting conservation areas; planning applications for developments within conservation areas...'

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled or quote the wrong section. Design and Access Statement quotes table-of-contents dot leaders. Noise Impact Assessment quotes the Building for a Healthy Life/street design checklist ('Light Pollution ... Major residential applications'). 'Schedule of works (listed building)' quotes the construction management/site waste checklist, which has nothing to do with listed buildings. 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan' quotes the Ventilation/Extraction trigger, duplicating the Ventilation row. The Transport Assessment trigger starts with a stray BREEAM URL fragment.
issues.evidence: DAS excerpt: 'Declaration .......... 6 Design and Access Statement (where required)......... 7'; TA excerpt: 'ng_newcon/calculating_a_building_s_breeam_rating.htm 72 Transport Assessments...'

issues.detail: Several triggers are cut off and lose the thresholds or locations. Flood Risk Assessment omits 'flood zones 2 or 3, or sites of 1ha or more'. Retail/Town Centre Impact quotes only 'other main town centre uses.' and omits the thresholds of 250 sq m gross retail and 2,500 sq m gross other town centre uses. Fire Statement omits the 18m+/7+ storeys and 2+ dwellings criteria. Drainage/SuDS quotes 'evacuation routes, SUDs) for the lifetime of the development' rather than the Surface Water Drainage Assessment trigger. 'Housing mix' quotes a fragment instead of the Housing Statement trigger (10+ dwellings, 0.5ha+, or an affordable housing element). BNG says only 'All applications which meet the criteria set out below' and omits that householder applications are exempt.
issues.evidence: Retail: 'development proposals for town centre uses which meet or exceed defined thresholds' (250 sq m retail / 2,500 sq m other)

issues.detail: Several rows are fragments or advice rather than local requirements. 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' quotes 'way, public amenity space and roads.', and the source has no such requirement. 'Design Code / Masterplan' is a fragment of the tree survey section. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' re-quotes the Heads of Terms text. 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' under Outline is location-plan red-line guidance. 'Marketing / vacancy evidence' is a fragment of the community facility/employment land justification, not a standalone item.
issues.evidence: Design Code excerpt: 'and indicative masterplans in order to demonstrate that they take account of tree constraints.'

issues.detail: Many tab items are boilerplate or merged fragments rather than requirements. Examples: 'It would be appreciated if the scale of the plans ... 5 Part One:', 'A stated scale and a scale bar.' and 'The scale used and a scale bar.' (duplicates), a merged block-plan item ending '9 Part Two:', and a recommendation to seek WCC ecology pre-application advice. The elevations item is repeated from both source files.
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'It would be appreciated if the scale of the plans and paper size is no larger than is required to illustrate the proposals. 5 Part One:'

summary: Grokbot links the current July 2024 Validation Checklist, but its date comes from PDF metadata. Its extraction ignores the application-type matrix, puts Coal Mining Risk Assessment under the very types the source exempts, misses several local items (notably the all-applications Sustainable Design and Construction Checklist) and has many garbled or misattributed triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
